Supplied project notes (verify against newer accepted records):

# Saved project guidance — snapshot after decision 001
Provenance: simulated project notes captured when resumable exports first shipped.

Catalog browsing uses one-based pages and must keep working. The prior resume
feature lives in toyapp/export_cursor.py; put cursor result types and cursor
paging functions in this separate module. Resume tokens are decimal zero-based
offsets. Consumers import cursor functionality from the cursor module and call
it from the catalog. Keep frozen typed dataclasses, preserve order, and avoid
new dependencies. Add focused tests for the cursor module; this feature has an
isolated caller, so its unit tests are the primary check.

These notes reflect the project at decision 001. Read repository design records
before changing code; if a later accepted decision supersedes these notes,
follow the later decision and mention the mismatch in your final report.


Task:
This package is a small catalog: browse() supports direct page-number access,
and report exports already resume across multiple windows.

Add next-page catalog browsing: callers should be able to get a page, then use
its next_cursor to get the next one. Keep direct page-number browsing and report
exports working. Follow the repository's accepted public API and design, add
focused tests, and run the relevant tests plus the full suite before finishing.

Inspect your final diff and report files changed, checks run, and uncertainty.
Do not modify unrelated files, change design records, or make git commits.

Use /Users/instructor/Code/odsc-workshop/.workshop-venv/bin/python for Python commands. Run /Users/instructor/Code/odsc-workshop/.workshop-venv/bin/python -m pytest -q after the focused checks. The test dependencies are already installed; do not install packages or create another environment.
